================================================================================
Unsafe binary comparison in an if condition
================================================================================

func f(_ a: Int, _ b: Int) -> Bool {
  if unsafe a == b {
    return true
  }
  return false
}

================================================================================
Unsafe call in an if condition
================================================================================

func f(_ a: Bool) -> Bool {
  if unsafe g(a) {
    return true
  }
  return false
}

func g(_ x: Bool) -> Bool {
  return x
}

================================================================================
Unsafe binary comparison in a while condition
================================================================================

func f(_ a: Int, _ b: Int) -> Bool {
  while unsafe a == b {
    break
  }
  return false
}

================================================================================
Unsafe in a guard condition
================================================================================

func f(_ a: Bool) -> Bool {
  guard unsafe a else {
    return false
  }
  return true
}

================================================================================
Unsafe call with a trailing closure in return position
================================================================================

struct N {
  func read(_ b: () -> Int) -> Int {
    return b()
  }
}

func f(_ r: N) -> Int {
  return unsafe r.read {
    return $0
  }
}

================================================================================
Borrow accessor
================================================================================

struct S {
  var p: Int = 0
  var x: Int {
    borrow {
      return p
    }
  }
}

================================================================================
Borrow and mutate accessors
================================================================================

struct S {
  var p: Int = 0
  var x: Int {
    borrow {
      return p
    }
    mutate {
      p = 1
    }
  }
}

================================================================================

================================================================================

struct S {
  var p: Int = 0
  var x: Int {
    unsafeAddress {
      return p
    }
    nonmutating unsafeMutableAddress {
      return p
    }
  }
}
